frontend_verification.evidenced: Live WebView2 DOM. Layout: isPlayCovered=false, gap=10px, paneScrollHeight==paneClientHeight (659/659, no page scrollbar). Captions: active class applied, brass rgb(214,164,85) on text and border, highlight moves on seek to 15s. Pictures: swap confirmed at 14.25s.
frontend_verification.not_evidenced: Job 3's three picture-boundary deltas. The claim is 0ms / 16.67ms / 0ms at 14.23s / 604.54s / 1078.32s, but the artifact records only the single swap at 14.25s. 16.67ms is one frame at 60fps, which is what a real rAF-driven measurement would give, so the claim is plausible - it is simply not backed by a file.

milestone_note: MILESTONE 2 COMPLETE. Slices G and H are committed and verified. The relay is parked at the owner gate: do NOT begin Milestone 3 until the owner acks. The next session's first job is to agree Milestone 3's scope with the owner, not to start building.

driver.cannot_spawn: Antigravity has no CLI entry point here. The driver notifies and waits when the token is with the builder. Set builder_command in config/relay_loop.json if that ever changes.
driver.milestone_gate: Stops at phase=MILESTONE_COMPLETE or ready_for=OWNER and waits for a phone ack.

review_findings: Slice G test test_seeking_across_two_hundred_effects_fires_none could not fail: its fixture put all 200 effects before the seek point, so a cursor parked at the end passed it. Proved by mutation - all 23 tests passed with seeking silently disabling every later effect. Closed by test_seek_then_play_forward_still_fires_later_effects.

The layout regression test could not fail: two of its four assertions matched strings already in style.css before the fix, and restoring aspect-ratio: 16/9 to .tl-frame - the original bug - still passed. Replaced with assertions scoped to the .tl-frame, .tl-transport, .tl-tracks and .pane[data-pane=timeline] rule bodies, verified to fail on that mutation.
known_gaps: Job 2, the caption auto-scroll, has no automated test. Its failure mode is visible rather than silent (the view just does not follow), so the risk is low, but it is untested.
The three picture-boundary deltas from Slice H Job 3 were reported but not written to an artifact. If picture drift matters in Milestone 3, measure it again and record it.
